# EasyFileMagic

> Free, no-signup, browser-based file tools — PDF, image, OCR, audio/video, data & AI — that run entirely on the user's device.

EasyFileMagic is a collection of 100+ free online utilities that process files entirely in the browser using JavaScript and WebAssembly. Nothing is uploaded to a server, so there is no account, no watermark, no daily limit, and no file-size cap beyond the device's memory. The main tools page lists every utility by category.

## Pages

- [All 104 tools](/tools): Every utility by category, with search.
- [Blog](/blog): Practical guides on file conversion, PDF editing, image formats, privacy, and tool usage.
- [About](/about): How the site works, why it is free, and its privacy model.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the EasyFileMagic team.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy — files never leave your device.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of use.

## PDF tools

- [Merge PDF](/tools/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDFs into one, preserving order.
- [PDF Editor](/tools/pdf-editor): Add text, images, highlights, drawings, shapes and signatures.
- [Compress PDF](/tools/compress-pdf): Shrink a PDF's file size for email or upload.
- [Sign PDF](/tools/sign-pdf): Draw or type a signature and place it on any page.
- [PDF ⇄ Word](/tools/pdf-word): Convert PDFs to editable Word files (and Word to PDF).
- See all PDF tools on the [tools page](/tools).

## Image tools

- [Image Converter](/tools/image-converter): Switch images between JPG, PNG and WEBP.
- [Compress Image](/tools/compress-image): Reduce JPG/PNG file size while keeping it sharp.
- [Remove Background](/tools/remove-background): Cut a subject out of a photo to a transparent PNG.
- [Resize & Crop Image](/tools/image-resize): Resize to exact pixel dimensions or crop visually.
- [HEIC to JPG](/tools/heic-to-jpg): Convert Apple HEIC photos to JPG or PNG in-browser.
- See all image tools on the [tools page](/tools).

## Convert tools

- [PDF to JPG](/tools/pdf-to-jpg): Turn every page of a PDF into a JPG image.
- [Image to PDF](/tools/image-to-pdf): Combine JPG or PNG photos into one PDF.
- [OCR (Image/PDF → Text)](/tools/ocr): Extract selectable text from images and scanned PDF pages.
- [Audio / Video Converter](/tools/media-convert): Convert MP4, WebM, MP3 and WAV in-browser.
- [Video to GIF](/tools/video-to-gif): Trim a clip and convert it to an optimized GIF.
- See all convert tools on the [tools page](/tools).

## Data & Utility tools

- [QR Code Generator](/tools/qr-code-generator): Turn a link or text into a downloadable QR code.
- [CSV ⇄ JSON](/tools/csv-json): Convert CSV to JSON or back.
- [Zip Files](/tools/zip-files): Bundle multiple files into one .zip archive.
- [Unix Timestamp Converter](/tools/timestamp-converter): Convert Unix timestamps to and from ISO 8601 dates.
- [Password Generator](/tools/password-generator): Strong, cryptographically-random passwords.
- See all data & utility tools on the [tools page](/tools).

## AI tools

- [AI Text Summarizer](/tools/ai-summarizer): Condense long text into a short summary.
- [AI Speech-to-Text](/tools/ai-transcribe): Transcribe audio with Whisper, client-side.
- [AI Image Caption Generator](/tools/ai-image-caption): Write captions for images.
- See all AI tools on the [tools page](/tools).
